title.zh: 免除八打雁省土地在1902年度缴纳土地税，并将该省土地估价与评定日期延展一年的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EXEMPTION OF THE LANDS IN THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS FROM PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, AND EXTENDING THE DATE FOR THE APPRAISEMENT AND ASSESSMENT OF LAND IN SAID PROVINCE FOR ONE YEAR.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EXEMPTION OF THE LANDS IN THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS FROM PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, AND EXTENDING THE DATE FOR THE APPRAISEMENT AND ASSESSMENT OF LAND IN SAID PROVINCE FOR ONE YEAR.
title.vi: Đạo luật miễn thuế đất cho đất đai tại tỉnh Batangas cho năm 1902 và gia hạn thời hạn định giá và đánh giá đất tại tỉnh này thêm một năm
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติยกเว้นการเก็บภาษีที่ดินสำหรับที่ดินในจังหวัดบาตังกัสสำหรับปี พ.ศ. 2445 และขยายกำหนดเวลาประเมินและประเมินค่าที่ดินในจังหวัดดังกล่าวออกไปหนึ่งปี
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pembebasan Tanah di Provinsi Batangas dari Pembayaran Pajak Tanah untuk Tahun 1902 dan Perpanjangan Masa Penilaian serta Penetapan Nilai Tanah di Provinsi Tersebut Selama Satu Tahun
title.ms: Akta tentang Pengecualian Tanah di Wilayah Batangas daripada Bayaran Cukai Tanah bagi Tahun 1902 dan Pelanjutan Tarikh Penilaian dan Penaksiran Tanah di Wilayah Berkenaan selama Setahun

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
In view of the depressed conditions prevailing in the Province of Batangas, due to its having been
recently subjected to severe losses by reason of the war, the collection of the land tax provided by the
Municipal Code and the Provincial Government Act is hereby suspended in said province for the year
nineteen hundred and two.

The date prescribed by section fifty-two of the Municipal Code for the appraisement and
assessment of lands for taxation purposes is hereby postponed in the Province of Batangas for the period of

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 11, 1902.
